ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "client_secret": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-id'), "name": attributes.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": attributes.headers.source, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId }

raise-error.description: There was an error trying to retrieve BillingDispute information

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { basePath: p("zsmart-sapi.base-path"), host: p("zsmart-sapi.host"), port: p("zsmart-sapi.port"), method: "GET", path: p('zsmart-sapi.resources.queryDispute.path'), body: {}, headers: vars.billingHeaders default {}, queryParameters: { "accountNumber": vars.billingParams.'BILLING_ACCOUNT', "msisdn": vars.billingParams.'CONNECTION_NUMBER', "channelCode": vars.billingParams.'ORIGIN', "queryClosedFlag": vars.billingParams.'QUERY_CLOSED_FLAG', "beginDate": vars.billingParams.'START_DATE', "endDate": vars.billingParams.'END_DATE' }, uriParameters: {} }

%dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { basePath: p("zsmart-sapi.base-path"), host: p("zsmart-sapi.host"), port: p("zsmart-sapi.port"), method: "GET", path: p('zsmart-sapi.resources.queryDispute.path'), body: {}, headers: vars.billingHeaders default {}, queryParameters: { "accountNumber": vars.billingAccount, "msisdn": vars.billingParams.'CONNECTION_NUMBER', "channelCode": vars.billingParams.'ORIGIN', "queryClosedFlag": vars.billingParams.'QUERY_CLOSED_FLAG', "beginDate": vars.billingParams.'START_DATE', "endDate": vars.billingParams.'END_DATE' }, uriParameters: {} }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var zsmartResponse = { "status": "success", "accountNumber": vars.billingAccount, "disputes": payload.result.result.disputeExDtoList map (dispute, index) -> { "disputeID": dispute.disputeID, "amount": dispute.amount, "remarks": dispute.remarks, "createdDate": dispute.createdDate, "status": dispute.status, "disputeItems": dispute.disputeItemExDtoList map (disputeItem, indez) -> { "glID": disputeItem.glID, "refInvoiceNumber": disputeItem.refInvoiceNumber, "amount": disputeItem.amount, "glTypeID": disputeItem.glTypeID, "glTypeName": disputeItem.glTypeName } } } --- vars.billingDisputeAcc + zsmartResponse
%dw 2.0 output application/java var zsmartResponse = { "status": "failed", "accountNumber": vars.billingAccount, "billingError": error.description } --- vars.billingDisputeAcc + zsmartResponse

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var totalCount = sizeOf(vars.billingDisputeAcc) default 0 var successCount = sizeOf(vars.billingDisputeAcc filter ($.status == "success")) default 0 var failedCount = sizeOf(vars.billingDisputeAcc filter ($.status == "failed")) default 0 var successAccounts = vars.billingDisputeAcc filter ($.status == "success") default [] var failedAccounts = vars.billingDisputeAcc filter ($.status == "failed") default [] --- { "codeResponse": if ( failedCount == 0 ) "200" else if ( failedCount < totalCount ) "207" else "500", "messageResponse": if ( failedCount == 0 ) "OK" else if ( failedCount < totalCount ) "PARTIAL_SUCCESS" else "FAILED", "accounts": successAccounts map $ - "status", "failedAccounts": failedAccounts, "summary": { "totalAccounts": totalCount, "processedAccounts": successCount, "failedAccounts": failedCount } }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var totalCount = sizeOf(vars.billingDisputeAcc) default 0 var failedCount = sizeOf(vars.billingDisputeAcc filter ($.status == "failed")) default 0 --- if ( failedCount == 0 ) 200 else if ( failedCount < totalCount ) 207 else 500
